title: LICHEN_COAP_SLOT_COORD never compiled on Zephyr 4.1: 14 errors in never-enabled code (snprintf, K_MUTEX_INITIALIZER, coap_core_metadata drift)
description: Discovered-from project-LICHEN-worker6-at2y (edge-cases review P0 follow-through). First-ever Zephyr build with CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_SLOT_COORD=y (SETTINGS+RPL+EPOCH_PERSIST+CCP16+TIME_SYNC chain enabled, native_sim coap_keys base) fails with 14 errors in coap_slot_coord.c regions untouched by at2y: :1441 implicit snprintf (missing <stdio.h>), :1483 K_MUTEX_INITIALIZER undeclared (host-stub-only macro path), :1711 -Wswitch-enum LICHEN_TIME_SOURCE_NONE unhandled, :1795/1815/1834 struct coap_core_metadata has no member 'attributes' (Zephyr 4.1 coap_service API drift — host test stubs freeze the old API). The host test (tests/coap_slot_claim) compiles this file with stub headers, so nothing ever compiled the Zephyr path. Fix: real includes (stdio.h/kernel.h), exhaustive switch, and update the coap_resource metadata initializers to the 4.1 coap_core_metadata shape (see coap_status.c or other in-tree resources for the current pattern).
